channel.capacityClaimBoundary: Maximum carrier capacity is not measured information or syntax.

chronology: Train once and retain all attempted episodes.
Freeze policy, optimizer, recurrent state, PRNG state, and authenticated training-ledger cutoff.
Run validation fitting and selection without updates.
Prepare normal messages and all final-test branch schedule.
Commit predictions, messages, identities and schedule before test receiver actions.
Restore identical pre-case state and execute paired branches.

A.replacementRule: At most two ordered technically invalid replacements, prospectively reserved and charged; depleted reserves close the cohort incomplete.

B.replacementRule: At most two ordered technically invalid replacements, prospectively reserved and charged; depleted reserves close the cohort incomplete.

cohorts.fallback: If the 20+20 reservation is unaffordable, 10+10 may be chosen before study collection on resource measurements only, manuscript marked preliminary; no silent partial larger plan.
cohorts.unit: independently trained dyad; role/case repetition does not increase N

costs.note: Caps bind via the amendment; this protocol adds no allowance.

evaluation.branchOrder: Deterministic seeded permutation per case, counterbalanced across cases.
evaluation.freezeRule: Freeze final policy bytes, optimizer state, checkpoint hidden state, PRNG state, and ledger cutoff before validation; no evaluation action updates policy, checkpoint, or PRNG state. Restoration is verified by actual weight/optimizer/state/PRNG comparison, not a stored boolean.
evaluation.interventionRule: Constant uses inventory element 0; random uses a dedicated uniform stream; shuffled uses a role-local derangement reconstructed from distinct cases with the selected source token verified (naturally coinciding tokens recorded, never forced; no shared target across shuffled cases; never the other receiver's ledger); ledger-consistent selects the native predictor's target-maximizing token with inventory-order ties; ledger-shuffled permutes those selected messages within role using a fixed derangement. The experimenter knows the target for this controlled intervention; receiver and baselines do not.
evaluation.receiverDecisionsDerivation: 5160 = 3000 training + 240 validation-fit + 240 validation-selection + 1680 test (240 cases x 7 branches); one receiver decision per training/validation episode.
evaluation.restoreRule: Restore the same final training state before every case and branch and each declared case boundary; a branch may advance its own state. Unchanged export hashes do not substitute for a verified live-state reset.
evaluation.sharedActionRandomness: Each case uses one privately derived uniform draw, shared across branches, disclosed to the auditor after sealing. Sampling uses a fixed candidate order and inverse CDF; the draw never enters any learner observation or prediction function.

execution.deadlineRule: Normal termination and resource guards are retained; existing Mode R deadline/safety code is unchanged and not claimed by this profile.
execution.releaseSchedule: none; no artificial one-second release padding in this declared Prototype profile

invalidity.replacement: Replacement consumes only ordered registered reserves; a depleted reserve pool closes the cohort incomplete.
invalidity.rule: Frozen technical rules only: wrong source or configuration, partition contamination, missing required evidence, broken chronology or restoration, or execution abort.
invalidity.validObservations: Low success, high loss, slow convergence and inconvenient estimates remain valid.

forbidden: policy updates during validation or test

observationSchemas.claimBoundary: Code-path and input-boundary checks must establish this restriction for these cooperative learners. This is logical separation under a trusted process and operator, not resistance to a malicious shared-process agent.
predictorForbidden: true test target in ordinary-record fits

forbidden: action draw or action PRNG values

observationSchemas.roleReading: agentAllowed and agentForbidden bind both roles except the sender row's own target flag: the sender's private referent cue is permitted sender-only input, and 'true scenario target' in agentForbidden binds receiver rows and ordinary-record predictor fits.

forbidden: action draw or action PRNG values

preActionCommitment.accessBoundary: Test outcomes and action PRNG values must be inaccessible to predictors at commitment time. Reveal/reconstruct draw information only for audit.
payload: full probability vectors for native, ordinary-record and replay predictors
preActionCommitment.persistence: Persist the committed canonical payloads. Hashing the inputs alone is insufficient.

question: Does a learner's contemporaneous token-association record predict its receiver actions better than a validation-selected predictor trained on ordinary observations and transcripts, and when does that prediction track causally effective communication?
relationshipToLV01: ALA-LV reuses LV01 v2's task, learner, channel, workload, predictor, branch, and Prototype execution values as an internal engine family, and explicitly acknowledges them. It is a smaller exploratory estimation study, not execution or completion of LV01's four-member confirmatory family. LV01's sample size, power requirement, margins, stage labels, and historical classifications are unchanged; no LV01 family support/power label may classify ALA cohorts.

retention.blobRule: Share immutable parent/model blobs by digest with explicit references; never clone a full bundle per branch. A digest-only record is a commitment, not an attached snapshot; missing attachments are failures.
retention.eventContent: every event identity and digest; log every update/event identity and digest
retention.replayQualification: Verify exact replay across retained checkpoint blocks; if exact replay fails, the retention format is unqualified.
retention.snapshotContent: full model, optimizer and hidden-state snapshots

scopeBoundary: One synthetic numeric referential task, one recurrent scratch-RL learner family, one fixed-token carrier.
Prototype Mode behavioral collection only; no hostile-process, timing-channel, or deployment-isolation claim.
No language-emergence, compositionality, acquisition, partner-transfer, human-audit, public-timestamp, independent-review, or full-program completion claim.
Estimation only: no confirmatory family, no power claim, no support labels.
All LV01/LV02/LG01/E00-E50 protocols, experiment IDs, and bytes remain unchanged.

derivation.algorithm: SHA-256 hex over UTF-8 parts joined by one NUL byte (same construction as LV01 v2; disjoint root)

seeds.retainedIdentityAudit: Before execution, audit every materialized seed against retained LV01 identities; any collision fails closed.
seeds.roleStreamSeparation: Per-role intervention-shuffle streams separate by concatenating the role code onto the 64-character hex base seed (hex followed by role).
seeds.rule: Every materialized seed is the SHA-256 hex of all applicable parts joined by single NUL bytes. Scenario/case identities and action draws omit branch only (paired branches share scenario, observation, pre-state, draw). Learner initialization occurs once per dyad.
seeds.slotIndexing: Engine-internal LV01-family calls receive disjoint engine slot numbers (cohort A primaries 0-19 + reserves 20-21; cohort B primaries 100-119 + reserves 120-121; development 200+; calibration 300+); external identity is always cohort/slotKind/slotIndex in this namespace.

task.claimBoundary: Fresh within-support cases are not new-type generalization or compositionality evidence.
task.duplicateRule: Canonical scenario content and IDs are distinct across partitions after outcome-free rederivation; deliberate seven-branch reuse inside one test case is required.
